notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Friendly and Enemy NPCs

New NPCs now roam the wasteland — both friendly and hostile
Over 40 unique interactions added
Encounters can now lead to:

Zombie hordes
Epic gunfights
Bonus loot drops
Dialogue and new characters


New Massive Locations

Added a Strip Mall in the Northwest corner of the map
Added a Country Club in the Northeast corner of the map

New Map Item

A new collectible map item can now be found in the wasteland

Updated Intro Animation

Refreshed the intro sequence with improved visuals and timing

notes.title: Upcoming Features for Dead Unending 2.0
notes.content:
Major Update for Dead Unending Coming May 2025!

I'm excited to announce a major update for Dead Unending arriving in May 2025! 

I’ll be posting updates throughout the development process as more content is added, and I’ll continue fixing bugs found during continuous playtesting

Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for your support!
